title: One-Loop Quantum Corrections to the Casimir Effect for Smoothly Rough Plates in the Low-Temperature Regime
summary: We present a theoretical analysis of the one-loop effective potential of a self-interacting real scalar field in the presence of two parallel conducting plates with geometric roughness. The analysis is restricted to the adiabatic regime of smoothly varying surface deformations, where derivative contributions to the surface profile can be neglected.
